class LRUCache:
    """
    A Least Recently Used (LRU) cache with Time To Live (TTL) support.
    
    This class implements an LRU cache where:
    - The cache has a maximum capacity (max_size).
    - When the cache is full, the least recently used item is evicted.
    - Each item can have an optional TTL (time to live) in seconds.
    - Items that have expired are considered missing and are removed upon access.
    - Accessing an item (get) updates its recency (moves it to the most recent).
    - Adding a new item (set) moves it to the most recent position.
    
    Attributes:
        max_size (int): Maximum number of items the cache can hold.
        default_ttl (float): Default TTL in seconds for items if not specified per-item.
        _cache (OrderedDict): Internal storage mapping keys to (value, expiry_time) tuples.
        _hits (int): Number of successful cache hits.
        _misses (int): Number of cache misses.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 100, default_ttl: Optional[float] = None):
        """
        Initialize the LRU cache.
        
        Args:
            max_size: Maximum number of items the cache can hold. Must be positive.
            default_ttl: Default time-to-live in seconds for all items. If None,
                         items never expire by default (unless specified per-item).

            ValueError: If max_size is not a positive integer
